# KITTY CORP — Comprehensive Knowledge Base & Technical Context

Official URL: https://thekittycorp.com
Commercial Studio URL: https://demo.thekittycorp.com
Headquarters: India
Leadership: Virat Anand (Founder & Chief Technologist)

## Company Overview
KITTY CORP is an elite AI robotics venture exploring the future of physical-world intelligence. We research, design, and develop autonomous mechanical machines that bridge artificial intelligence with physical kinematics, real-world navigation, and planetary-scale operational challenges.

---

## Strategic Architecture

### 1. Official Corporate Property (thekittycorp.com)
The primary institutional domain dedicated exclusively to advanced AI robotics research, engineering concepts, membership, and founder narrative.
- **Hero Experience**: Scroll-driven procedural 3D WebGL exploded assembly demonstrating a calibrated humanoid cybernetic system converging across 10 mechanical axes.
- **R&D Projects**: Early concept presentations for Project 01 (AgriYaan) and Project 02 (Green Energy).
- **Membership**: 1-Year Verified Metallic Membership providing private access to engineering briefings, whitepapers, and research progress.

### 2. Commercial Digital Solutions Studio (demo.thekittycorp.com)
Our dedicated commercial platform serving enterprises, startups, and institutions seeking premier digital engineering:
- **Websites & Portals**: Custom high-conversion digital architectures and applications.
- **Business Automation**: Algorithmic workflows, pipeline orchestration, and ERP integrations.
- **Custom AI Solutions**: Domain-specific fine-tuned models, intelligent document processing, and autonomous agents.

---

## Core Research Projects

### Project 01: AGRIYAAN
- **Classification**: Autonomous Agricultural Field Robotics
- **Badge**: Concept Exploration
- **Mission**: AI for Smarter Agriculture.
- **Technical Architecture**:
  - Multi-spectral crop health assessment and computer vision diagnostics.
  - High-torque all-terrain rocker-bogie chassis for rugged farmland traversal.
  - Edge-compute neural inference for targeted weeding, variable-rate spraying, and harvest readiness detection.
  - Solar-supplemented power architecture with autonomous base-station docking.

### Project 02: GREEN ENERGY
- **Classification**: Intelligent Clean Energy Automation
- **Badge**: Concept Exploration
- **Mission**: AI for a Sustainable Future.
- **Technical Architecture**:
  - Reinforcement learning for dynamic wind turbine pitch and yaw micro-adjustments.
  - Computer vision and irradiance telemetry for high-precision dual-axis solar tracking.
  - Predictive battery energy storage system (BESS) dispatch algorithms forecasting grid peak loads.
  - Decentralized microgrid telemetry for resilient rural power distribution.

---

## 1-Year Verified Membership Architecture
- **Purpose**: Community and patron support for independent AI robotics and clean energy research.
- **Credentials**: Bespoke laser-etched matte dark metallic card featuring embedded NFC telemetry.
- **Key Inclusions**:
  - Verified physical and digital membership credentials.
  - Invitations to private technical research briefings and architecture townhalls.
  - Early access to engineering whitepapers, telemetry datasets, and CAD schematics.
  - Direct quarterly updates from founder Virat Anand.
- **Explicit Disclosures**:
  - Membership is strictly non-equity and confers no company ownership, financial dividends, or investment returns.
  - Voluntary technological research support model.
  - Distinct from commercial digital services contracted through the commercial studio.
- **URL**: https://thekittycorp.com/memberships

## Founder Narrative
KITTY CORP was founded by Virat Anand with a singular vision: to push intelligence beyond digital screens and into physical reality. From everyday human collaboration to rugged agricultural fields, renewable energy networks, and planetary frontiers, KITTY CORP approaches engineering with unapologetic ambition and relentless scientific curiosity.

---

## Technical & Security Infrastructure
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack, React 19)
- **3D Graphics Engine**: Three.js WebGL (procedural 10-subsystem kinematic model, ACESFilmic tonemapping, frame-rate independent exponential damping, zero external model latency).
- **Database & State**: Supabase PostgreSQL with strict Row Level Security (RLS).
- **Payment Clearing**: Razorpay with cryptographic HMAC SHA-256 signature verification.
- **Security & Reliability**: Content Security Policy (CSP), strict HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS), Cloudflare Turnstile bot verification, and zero layout shift design.
